title: The Oath of Ashvale
premise: Ivo Ravensworth has spent ten years as the king's taster, swallowing poison by increments and memorizing the hidden roads that thread the Thornfell mountains. When the border wards collapse on a starless night, he discovers the court beneath the mountain has begun collecting souls sold in secret by the crown itself — and among them is Wren, the smuggler he loved and betrayed to save his own skin. To steal her soul back, Ivo must ally with a disgraced ward-keeper and a poisoner-turned-priest, descending through the mountain's courts where justice is a currency and power devours its holders. He wins her back only by surrendering his own hard-won immunity — taking into himself the curse meant for her — and the book ends with Wren carrying him into the sunrise he can no longer see, their oaths remade on ash rather than gold.
about_author: Emrys Brightwater is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloging medieval trial records before turning to fiction. They write fantasy about ordinary functionaries caught in extraordinary bargains, and live somewhere rainy with an opinionated cat.

chapters.title: The Taster's Tongue
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. A routine tasting at the royal table — Ivo detects henbane in a stew and saves a duke's life, earning cold gratitude and no thanks. Introduces his immunity, his loneliness, and the ledger of flavors he keeps. Emotional beat: competence as a cage.

chapters.title: Wren in the Wine Cellar
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV, flashback woven into present. He smuggles contraband wine for Wren, the Thornfell courier he once loved, through a cellar door only tasters know. Their old banter masks an old wound: the betrayal that sent her into exile. Emotional beat: tenderness with a blade under it.

chapters.title: The Night Without Stars
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Every star over Thornfell goes dark at once; the border wards die with them. Panic in the palace, and a royal summons: Ivo's knowledge of smuggler roads makes him expendable and essential. Emotional beat: dread arriving on schedule.

chapters.title: The King's Bargain
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The king offers Ivo a pardon for Wren — if he retrieves a sealed casket from the mountain court before the new moon. Ivo recognizes the royal seal on old soul-contracts. He accepts for her sake. Emotional beat: love weaponized by duty.

chapters.title: Roads Only Smugglers Know
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. He travels the hidden passes, finding wards burned out and villages empty, doors chalked with the under-court's spiral sigil. First glimpse of the mountain breathing. Emotional beat: the map he trusted is a map of losses.

chapters.title: The Ward-Keeper's Gallows
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV; introduces Serah Vail, a disgraced ward-keeper about to be hanged by her own order for failing Thornfell. Ivo cuts her down because she knows what killed the wards. Emotional beat: justice outside the law begins with a rope.

chapters.title: What the Wards Were For
chapters.summary: Serah's POV. She explains the wards never kept armies out — they kept the mountain's court from collecting debts. The crown has been selling souls for a century of borrowed power. Emotional beat: the horror of paperwork.

chapters.title: The Casket Opens
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Forced open by bandits, the royal casket holds not gold but a name written in ash: Wren's. Ivo realizes he was sent to deliver her soul, not save her. Emotional beat: betrayal repeated by his own hands.

chapters.title: Ash and Ledger
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. He burns the casket — a mistake; the ash reforms and marks him as a debtor in the under-court's ledger. The mountain now has a claim on him too. Emotional beat: guilt made literal.

chapters.title: The Poisoner's Chapel
chapters.summary: Introduce Brother Quill, a poisoner turned priest who ministers to the soul-marked. His chapel is a field hospital for people the mountain is slowly collecting. He agrees to guide them — for a debt of his own. Emotional beat: grace in a poisoned man.

chapters.title: Toll of the First Gate
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. At the mountain's first gate, the toll is a memory. Ivo pays one of Wren — the taste of her laugh — and feels it gone. Emotional beat: love measured in installments.

chapters.title: The Court Beneath
chapters.summary: Serah's POV. The under-court revealed: a mirrored palace where the gentry are centuries old and beautiful and hollow, sustained by harvested souls. Ivo spots Wren's soul among the caged lights. Emotional beat: wonder curdling into rage.

chapters.title: An Old Debt Recognized
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The under-court's steward recognizes Ivo's ledger-mark and offers him a deal: his immunity, his rare poison-proof soul, for Wren's freedom. Tempting — his gift was built for this. Emotional beat: the offer that knows your name.

chapters.title: Refusal and Consequence
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Ivo refuses the trade, demanding her soul whole and free, not exchanged. The steward smiles and sets a hunt on the party. Emotional beat: pride as both virtue and doom.

chapters.title: Running the Mirrored Halls
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV, breathless chase through the court where every reflection shows a different regret. Quill's poisons and Serah's dying ward-craft buy them the exit. Emotional beat: terror with gallows humor.

chapters.title: The Smuggler's Code
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV, quiet chapter. Wounded, they shelter in a smuggler's cache Ivo stocked years ago. He confesses the original betrayal to Serah: he gave Wren's name to the crown to save his own post. Emotional beat: confession without absolution.

chapters.title: Serah's Verdict
chapters.summary: Serah's POV. She was exiled for a failure that was really the order's corruption; she judges Ivo and finds him guilty but worth saving. They swear a private oath — not to the crown, to each other. Emotional beat: justice as chosen loyalty.

chapters.title: Quill's Confession
chapters.summary: Brother Quill's POV. His debt: he poisoned the original ward-stones a century of favors ago, believing he served the poor. The stars went out because his sin finally compounded. Emotional beat: an old man's reckoning.

chapters.title: The New Moon Deadline
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The new moon is when the under-court finalizes collections; after it, Wren's soul is spent as fuel for the gentry's immortality. Three days left. Emotional beat: the clock becomes a character.

chapters.title: Allies Among the Marked
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The soul-marked villagers, led by a chalk-sigil girl named Pip, offer numbers and knowledge of the mountain's service tunnels in exchange for a promise: end the collections. Emotional beat: the powerless organizing.

chapters.title: The Gentry's Feast
chapters.summary: Serah's POV, infiltration. Disguised as servants, they witness a feast where a consumed soul's memories play across a gentry lord's face — including, briefly, Wren's. Emotional beat: grief as reconnaissance.

chapters.title: What Power Tastes Like
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The steward offers Ivo a seat at court — his immunity makes him valuable, a gentry who cannot be poisoned by rivals. Ivo understands the corruption from inside: it always offers you a chair. Emotional beat: temptation refined.

chapters.title: Pip's Map of Wounds
chapters.summary: Pip's POV. The girl shows them where the mountain's heart-ward is weakest — the same place Quill poisoned it long ago. The plan: reforge the wards from inside, freeing all held souls at once. Emotional beat: hope with a battle plan.

chapters.title: The Price of Reforging
chapters.summary: Serah's POV. Reforging requires a soul willingly given as the new anchor-stone. Serah volunteers; Ivo refuses to let her. The argument tears the alliance. Emotional beat: sacrifice contested.

chapters.title: Wren's Voice in the Dark
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV, dream-sequence. Her caged soul reaches for him: not blame, but a question — what will you become to save me? He wakes weeping. Emotional beat: love asking the hard question.

chapters.title: The Second Gate Toll
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The gate demands a truth this time. Ivo speaks his betrayal aloud to the mountain itself, and the gate — older and fairer than the court — lets him pass. Emotional beat: honesty as toll.

chapters.title: Betrayal at the Heart-Ward
chapters.summary: Quill's POV. At the threshold, Quill falters — the court has promised to erase his guilt rather than punish it. He nearly turns on them; Pip talks him back from the edge. Emotional beat: corruption's last offer.

chapters.title: The Steward's True Face
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The steward is revealed as the first taster — the man whose immunity the crown copied, harvested and hollowed into a servant. Ivo sees his own future in the thing. Emotional beat: mirror-horror.

chapters.title: Storming the Soul-Vault
chapters.summary: Full battle chapter, rotating POV. Pip's marked villagers flood the service tunnels; Serah holds the gate; Quill poisons the gentry's wine — a taster's war fought with a taster's tools. Emotional beat: catharsis in motion.

chapters.title: The Cage of Lights
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. He reaches Wren's soul-cage and finds it locked to a royal seal — his own king's signature. To open it he must formally accuse the crown before the mountain's court. Emotional beat: the accusation he was always building toward.

chapters.title: Ivo Ravensworth v. The Crown
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. In the under-court's judgment hall, Ivo presents a decade of tasted poisons, ledgers, and seals — the taster's palate as testimony. The court, bound by older law than the crown's, must hear it. Emotional beat: the quiet man's thunder.

chapters.title: Verdict
chapters.summary: Serah's POV. The mountain rules the contracts void — but the gentry refuse to release the souls, and the court itself begins to fracture. Chaos; the steward moves to consume everything rather than yield. Emotional beat: victory that triggers the endgame.

chapters.title: The Steward Unbound
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The unleashed steward comes for Wren's soul first, and Ivo does the one thing no one expects: he offers his immunity — his poison-proof soul — as the anchor for the new ward. Emotional beat: the gift finally given away.

chapters.title: The Reforging
chapters.summary: Serah and Quill's POV, interwoven. They forge the ward around Ivo's offered soul as the mountain shakes and the gentry burn like paper. Quill dies completing his century-old correction, at peace. Emotional beat: sacrifice completed, sin absolved.

chapters.title: What the Mountain Keeps
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Wren's soul is freed — but Ivo's immunity is gone, spent into the ward, and the curse meant for her settles into his unprotected body. He hides it. Emotional beat: love as a secret wound.

chapters.title: Sunrise on Thornfell
chapters.summary: Wren's POV, restored. She wakes at the mountain's foot with no memory of her captivity and finds Ivo changed, dimmed, smiling. The stars return overhead. Emotional beat: reunion shadowed by cost.

chapters.title: The Crown's Reckoning
chapters.summary: Serah's POV. The evidence Ivo lodged with the mountain's court surfaces in the world above; the king's soul-trade is exposed. Serah is restored, then resigns — justice no longer needs her old order. Emotional beat: institutions fall, people remain.

chapters.title: A Taster Without Immunity
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The poison he absorbed is slow, and he knows it. He spends his remaining strength writing the true account — this book — and teaching Wren every smuggler road he knows. Emotional beat: legacy over survival.

chapters.title: The Last Dish
chapters.summary: Wren's POV. She cooks for him, one final meal, every flavor he once cataloged for kings now given to him freely. He tastes it fully — the first honest pleasure of his life. Emotional beat: grace in smallness.

chapters.title: Oath of Ashvale
chapters.summary: Wren and Serah's POV, closing. On the ash-grey slopes, Wren carries Ivo to see the sunrise he can barely see; they speak vows not of duty but of choice. The ward holds, the stars burn, and his story — told in his own voice — ends in her hands. Emotional beat: love outlasting the price.
